scope: Intraday Formal FIRST-entry semantics only; no claim that looser or stricter BUY is economically superior.

currentFormal.BBreakoutConfirmed: any bar in latest 12 completed bars with close>=breakout*1.003, volumeRatio>=1.3, strongClose, upperShadowRatio<0.45
currentFormal.BRetestBuy: latest bar touches [buyLow,buyHigh], closes>=breakout*0.997, volumeRatio null OR <=1.1, bullish and reversalK/strongClose, upperShadowRatio<0.45
currentFormal.BFailure: latest close<retestLow => risk text '突破後回測失守承接區，B取消'
currentFormal.planFirstCondition: 先確認有效突破；不追第一段，等待回測突破價/承接區守住，完整15分K再轉強才第一筆

falsifiedConcerns.concern: Formal B can use the exact same 15m bar as both breakout-confirmation and retest BUY.
falsifiedConcerns.reason: A breakout-confirming latest bar requires volumeRatio>=1.3, while a retest BUY on latest requires volumeRatio<=1.1 when finite. Breakout requires finite volumeRatio, so null cannot bridge the conflict.
falsifiedConcerns.consequence: Do not report same-bar breakout+retest as a defect.

confirmedFindings.construction: buildBar volumeRatio is current bar volume divided by previous five completed same-session bars; index<5 => volumeRatio=null.
confirmedFindings.exactTiming: The first 15m bar with finite Formal volumeRatio is the sixth bar, starting 10:15 and completing 10:30. Bars starting 09:00,09:15,09:30,09:45,10:00 can never satisfy B breakout confirmation on their own.
confirmedFindings.formalEffect: An early breakout before 10:30 can contribute high/close attempts but cannot be a breakoutConfirmed bar unless a later qualifying breakout bar occurs.
confirmedFindings.direction: Can reduce participation/BUY opportunity; may also protect against opening-auction/early-session noise. Economic value UNKNOWN.

confirmedFindings.construction: evaluateMomentum is stateless across lifecycle except the rolling recent-bar window. breakoutConfirmed scans any qualifying bar in recent 12; failure checks only the current latest bar.
fixedWitness: bar1: valid breakout-confirmation remains inside recent[]
bar2: close < breakout*0.995 or <retestLow => Formal returns risk/'B取消', while stop remains unbroken
bar3: recovers into retest zone, closes>=breakout*0.997, volumeRatio<=1.1, bullish+turn-up, no long upper shadow
confirmedFindings.formalEffect: On bar3, old bar1 still makes breakoutConfirmed=true. Because bar2 failure is not persisted, bar3 can return BUY without a fresh qualifying breakout after the failure.
confirmedFindings.comparator: V8.11 PV Shadow acceptance lifecycle transitions to B_FAILED_REENTRY and has no reactivation transition from that terminal state in pvAdvanceAcceptance.
confirmedFindings.direction: Can increase participation after a prior invalidation. Whether recovery should require fresh breakout is a strategy/lifecycle question; Formal change would be Class C.

confirmedFindings.construction: buildFinalDecision can emit risk from momentum15, but evaluateOperationSignals emits PLAN_INVALIDATED only when stop.level==='risk'. It does not persistently cancel a NONE-stage plan merely because momentum15 text says 'B取消'.
confirmedFindings.formalEffect: A B failure can be visible as current monitor risk yet not mutate plan lifecycle; later stateless recomputation may re-qualify.
confirmedFindings.guard: This is a lifecycle/notification semantics finding, not proof of a missed or bad trade.

confirmedFindings.construction: Formal previous-five same-session 15m volumeRatio is null for the first five completed bars. B cannot confirm breakout until bar 6 (~10:30), and same-bar breakout+retest BUY is impossible because >=1.3 and <=1.1 volume conditions conflict. A needs bar 6 as the previous finite-volume acceptance bar plus bar 7 turn-up.
confirmedFindings.A: Earliest theoretical BUY is bar 7, completing about 10:45.
confirmedFindings.B: Earliest theoretical breakout confirmation is bar 6 (~10:30); earliest distinct retest BUY is bar 7, completing about 10:45.
confirmedFindings.interpretation: Both channels share an approximate first-105-minutes no-BUY structural window under normal 15m timing. Channel logic differs inside that window, but earliest theoretical Formal BUY is not materially asymmetric.
confirmedFindings.caveat: This is source-level timing geometry, not proof that every market day/provider returns identical bucket boundaries.

volumeSemantics.currentFormal: same-session previous-five-bar ratio, rounded to two decimals
volumeSemantics.knownResearchComparator: V8.11 PV Shadow same-slot RVOL + cumulative pace
volumeSemantics.existingResearchStatus: Price-Volume lane already preregisters current previous-five ratio versus same-slot RVOL; do not duplicate threshold search.
volumeSemantics.openingRisk: First 09:00 15m bar mixes opening auction/early continuous state in PV research; early-session blindness may be protective, not automatically a defect.

prospectiveTests: Count selected B plans whose first meaningful breakout attempt/close occurs before Formal volumeRatio becomes available.
Among complete-coverage B plans, classify EARLY_BREAKOUT_ONLY, LATER_RECONFIRMED, NO_BREAKOUT, FORMAL_BUY.
Count episodes with a qualifying breakout, then intervening Formal B failure, then later Formal BUY without a fresh post-failure breakout.
Use V8.11 acceptance state history as an independent chronology comparator, but do not silently treat its stricter B_REACCELERATION state as Formal truth.
Compare missed-upside versus avoidance-benefit for early-breakout-only NO-BUY plans after costs/coverage controls.
Compare post-failure resurrection BUY paths versus fresh-breakout-after-failure paths separately.
Stratify by A/B, time-of-day, opening gap, slot RVOL, liquidity, regime and maxChase.
falsification: If early breakouts before 10:30 have materially worse false-break/MAE/execution outcomes, retain the blind window or treat it as protective.

If early-breakout-only plans show stable OOS missed-upside with acceptable risk and same-slot evidence resolves opening noise, a future time-of-day/volume-baseline reformulation may become a candidate.
If post-failure resurrection BUY performs as well or better than requiring a fresh breakout, terminal cancellation may be unnecessarily strict.
If resurrection BUY is materially worse or semantically inconsistent with intended cancellation, surface a future lifecycle correction candidate.
No BUY threshold/window may be tuned from retrospective winners.

engineeringBoundary.researchCapture: Class A if only existing Formal/PV state is compared and persisted research-only with no signal impact.
engineeringBoundary.recorderCompleteness: Class B proposal-first if exact-date exhaustive monitor capture requires shared runtime/storage changes.

conclusions: The early-session restriction is a shared Formal BUY timing boundary rather than an A-vs-B earliest-BUY asymmetry; both channels are structurally unable to issue their first theoretical 15m BUY before roughly 10:45 under the current previous-five-bar volume construction.
